meta.note: Factors are small and composable; process_bindings compiles the per-company product. Every activity carries the stable APQC pcf_id of the process it belongs to, resolved in the framework the stream's industry names (pcf_framework; cross_industry for universal streams); tools/check_catalogue_pcf.py and tests/test_process_bindings.py verify every id against the shipped frameworks. Regional variants and product objects are from public vendor and regulator documentation; verify before shipping a pack.

order_to_cash.name: Order to Cash
activities: invoice equals delivered qty x price

acquire_to_retire.name: Acquire to Retire
activities: Register in asset ledger and CMDB

AU.e_invoicing: PEPPOL; Commonwealth agencies mandated, private voluntary

IN.e_invoicing: IRP e-invoice with IRN; mandatory above turnover threshold (INR 5 crore)

JP.e_invoicing: Qualified Invoice System (Oct 2023); PEPPOL JP PINT

KR.e_invoicing: e-Tax invoice via NTS (mandatory for corporations)
